component.name: vinoPilot
component.summary: The vinoPilot family of AI apps for Intel NPUs

description.p: vinoPilot is a family of apps for Linux laptops with an Intel NPU. They bring Copilot+ PC features to Linux: live captions, face unlock, video call effects, AI text tools, text-to-speech and search. Everything runs offline on the NPU with OpenVINO, so there's no account or cloud service, and it's easy on the battery.
This app is the family's home: one window to install, update and uninstall the rest of it.

ul.li: vinoWhisper: live captions and voice typing
vinoAuthFace: unlock and sudo with your face
vinoOpenEffects: look better on video calls
vinoPop: AI actions on any text you select
vinoSearch: find files by what they're about
vinoWatch: see what your NPU is doing
ovfetch: fetches the OpenVINO runtime the NPU needs

description.p: Each app installs through its own installer from its GitHub release, checked against the release's checksums, or from source, PyPI or crates.io. vinoPilot also finds apps you installed before it, shows how each one got there, and updates it the same way. Nothing goes online until you press Check for updates.
The apps install on your system, not in a sandbox: into your home folder with your own tools, and vinoAuthFace system-wide, after asking for your password.

screenshot.caption: The window: a card per app, with its version and how it was installed

ul.li: Uninstalling an app removes its downloaded models and keeps your data
A .deb, an .rpm and a Flatpak on every release
vinoPilot updates and uninstalls itself as the package it came in
The version in the header checks for a newer vinoPilot, updates it and restarts the window
An About popup says how vinoPilot and its commands are installed
